message:
docs(update): 3.11.0 pointed at a rule 3.12 did not contain

The two-phase section says health knows there is nothing to wait for when
nothing that reports was brought back, and cites 3.12 for it. Following
the citation found nothing: the rule was in the code and in no document.
A reference that does not resolve is worse than no reference, because it
spends the reader's trust before failing.

3.12 now carries both halves, and they are opposites worth stating
together. Nothing that reports came back, so there is nothing to wait for
-- otherwise an update whose files are entirely correct gets rolled back
because some process was not running before it started. And nothing was
relaunched at all, so "healthy" is not an answer -- that one is answering
a question nobody asked. Each maps to one branch of healthDetail.

While there, every internal section reference in the design was checked
and all nine resolve.
